questions.original: Use the credictcard-reduced.csv dataset and build Five classification models. Please plot confusion matrix, and evaluate your model performance using accuracy, precision, recall, F-score (50 points). A list of classification models can be found [here](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/auto_examples/classification/plot_classifier_comparison.html)

answers.chinese: 用指定交易 CSV 建五个分类模型，各画一个混淆矩阵，并分别报告 accuracy、precision、recall、F-score。
answers.english: In the saved A08 reference analysis, all five classifiers were evaluated on the same 13,035 held-out records with Class 1 as positive.

answers.english: In this saved split, AdaBoost has the highest F1, while Decision Tree and Random Forest tie in accuracy but make different errors.

questions.original: Use the class-weight method from the tutorial for imbalanced classification on the creditcard-reduced.csv dataset. Build a classifier with and without class_weight, then evaluate model performance before and after applying class weights using accuracy, precision, recall, F-score, and confusion matrix.(20 points)

answers.chinese: 固定数据划分和同一种分类器，对比不加权与加权版本，把混淆矩阵和四种数值指标全部报出。
answers.english: On the same held-out records, weighting leaves recall unchanged but raises false alarms from five to seven.
